children: Metro has reached a tentative agreement with the union representing distribution, transportation and administrative employees in Quebec, potentially bringing to an end a five-and-a-half month labor strike.

The Canadian grocer said Thursday that it has reached the agreement in principle with STTEUMR for the renewal of the collective agreement with 550 union employees at the produce distribution center in Laval. The lengthy labor dispute has been ongoing since March 30.
The agreement will be submitted to employees for a ratification vote on Sept. 24.
